name: Hand-drawn doodles around the speaker
description: Five to eight bold hand-drawn doodles draw themselves around the speaker's head, never on the face: a little orange-and-black bar chart, a plus, a triangle, a squiggle, a star, sparkles, a scribbled loop, a curvy arrow, a thick arc or emphasis dashes; an optional white chip with a short stat like '+248%' pops under the bar chart.
use_when: Lines about creativity, motion graphics, visuals, making something fun or eye-catching, 'adds some flair', growth and energy; good under an excited or playful sentence.

tag.help: optional short stat chip under the bar chart, e.g. '+248%'; empty hides it

seed.help: any whole number; changes which doodles appear and their tilt
